description: Top AI researchers and engineers from EU member states increasingly relocate to jurisdictions with both frontier access and political stability, citing career stagnation and systemic irrelevance. Labs report hiring freezes and talent poaching from abroad, accelerating the EU's technical decline.

Local moratoriums on data centres spread to eight member states, coordinated through shared legal templates. Grid stability concerns are cited, but energy ministers privately admit political pressure is mounting, driven by public anger over energy costs and AI's perceived lack of benefit.
